summary: Snowboarder Jesse Ebert ducked under a rope at Teo I at Crested Butte Mountain Resort and spent several hours trying to hike out of the Teo drainage below Teocalli Bowl; ski patrol searched the base area after his fiancee reported him missing ~4 p.m., then began a perimeter search, made contact ~8 p.m., gave him water and snacks, and had him hike out on snowshoes — uninjured.
location: Teo drainage below Teocalli Bowl, Crested Butte Mountain Resort
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Resort Ski Patrol
